To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

• Alternative risk premia are an extension of the traditional factor investing approach, • They are not a substitute to traditional risk premias (equities, bonds, cash) but rather a complement, • Alternative risk premias can be decomposed into skewness risk premias and market anomalies, • The most frequent alternative risk premiums are carry and momentum and they have very different statistical properties, • Risk diversification cannot be only reduced to volatility diversiﬁcation but must also consider skewness risk
